other_exits: Close long when Awesome Oscillator (bar[1]) crosses below 0.0013 from above (AO was above level, now below)
Close short when Awesome Oscillator (bar[1]) crosses above -0.0013 from below (AO was below negative level, now above)
Force close on Friday session close (sessionCloseAtFridayClose=true)
Trailing stop closes position when trailing stop equals current bid (buy) or ask (sell)

custom_logic_notes: Entry requires ALL four filters to agree simultaneously (AND combination). Stochastic Signal (ind0) uses %K/%D crossover on bar[1]. Stochastic ind1 checks if MAIN_LINE on bar[2] is above level 20 (long) or below 100-20=80 (short). Stochastic ind2 checks if MAIN_LINE on bar[2] is below level 75 (long) or above 100-75=25 (short). Note: ind1 long condition requires stochastic ABOVE 20 (already moved up from oversold), while ind2 long requires stochastic BELOW 75 (not yet overbought) — this creates a zone filter requiring the stochastic to be in a mid-range (20-75 for longs, 25-80 for shorts). AC crossover on bar[1] vs bar[2] confirms momentum shift. Exit uses Awesome Oscillator crossing a threshold level (0.0013/-0.0013) on bar[1] vs bar[2]. Trailing stop uses High(1)-SL_points for buys and Low(1)+SL_points for sells but is disabled by default (isTrailingStop=false). If both long and short conditions are true simultaneously, no trade is taken. Order filling type auto-fallback: FOK->IOC->RETURN on TRADE_RETCODE_INVALID_FILL. Trade retry up to 4 times with 100ms wait. Sunday trading is ignored. Session times are all 00:00-24:00 (effectively no session restriction except Sunday and Friday close).
python_conversion_notes: This EA uses only standard MT5 built-in indicators easily available via MetaTrader5 Python package (iStochastic, iAC, iAO). Key considerations: (1) Entry signals use bar[1] and bar[2] — previous and 2-bars-ago — meaning signals are generated at the open of the current bar after the previous bar closes. (2) The pip calculation uses a custom function GetPipValue that maps digit counts to pip values — must replicate exactly. (3) SL/TP are in pips (not points), so for 5-digit EURUSD, 40 pips = 0.0040. (4) The sigma=0.000001 tolerance for floating point comparisons must be preserved. (5) The AC indicator crossover check compares bar[2] value below threshold AND bar[1] value above threshold — this is a 2-bar crossover detection, not a single-bar condition. (6) Trailing stop logic uses High[1]/Low[1] of previous bar, but is disabled by default. (7) The order filling type detection and fallback logic (FOK->IOC->RETURN) should be handled in Python. (8) Session filtering logic is present but configured for 24/7 except Sunday and Friday close — should be configurable.
